R7AA-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AA-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
14 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-12, Region 7A Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.

Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 7A table (page 57), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). MU 7-1 is listed in Region 7A on page 2 but no row names it.

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 96 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.74298, -125.01898, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 1.5 km to the start. Ride: the 48 Road FSR stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 100 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-12, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-grouse-atv-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-12: about 19,786 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 3.79 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 95 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 16, Lily Lake Rd, Smith Creek Rd, Holy Cross FSR.
Park: 53.69551, -124.97333, where the truck road ends (Holy Cross 51A FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.0 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 240 m W, climb about 1 m.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-4, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-moose-atv-0005.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-4: about 1,452 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.16 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 1 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
